cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Make the Choice Rewrite the Past
cards.instruction: Make them choose between options whose consequences reinterpret an earlier promise, refusal, or agreement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Keep my spare key or return it. Either choice explains last week's 'take some space.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then keeping it can mean the evening ended.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would make that evening the beginning of something neither of us named.

mechanism: A corrects its former pupil vague request for space by making keeping or returning a key define whether last week was a pause or beginning of departure.
confusable: Not just requesting the key back: the present choice retroactively interprets the earlier quiet-evening request.
comparison: Shared work promise versus ambiguous household separation.
seedUse: D226 spare key/space/quiet evening/keep/return; S05 saying precisely what meant.
